title.zh: 谷歌将投资170亿美元，在怀俄明州建设其首个数据中心
title.en: 谷歌将投资170亿美元，在怀俄明州建设其首个数据中心

current_state.zh: Google committed $17 billion to build its first Wyoming data center in Laramie County, pairing the capital with binding utility agreements and a 702MW Bloom Energy fuel-cell project featuring carbon capture and storage.
current_state.en: Google committed $17 billion to build its first Wyoming data center in Laramie County, pairing the capital with binding utility agreements and a 702MW Bloom Energy fuel-cell project featuring carbon capture and storage.
